info.description: Complete API documentation for the ticket management system
info.title: Ticket Management System API

post.description: Add a new comment to a ticket
Authenticate user with email and password

get.description: Get new access token using refresh token from cookie

post.description: Create a new ticket (accessible to all authenticated users)

get.description: Retrieve a list of tickets. Without filter query parameters, listing follows role rules (admin: all, agent: assigned, user: created). With any of state, priority, created_by, assignee, assigned_to, or ticket_number, filters are applied with the same role scoping (non-admins cannot widen scope via query params).

parameters.description: Filter by priority (critical, high, medium, low)
parameters.name: priority

parameters.description: Filter by creator user UUID (admin only; standard users are scoped to self)
parameters.name: created_by

parameters.description: Filter by assignee user UUID (admin or matching agent)
parameters.name: assignee

get.description: Retrieve tickets assigned to the current user
Retrieve ticket by its ticket number
Get ticket statistics based on user role (admin/agent see all, users see own)
Retrieve full details of a specific ticket

delete.description: Permanently delete a ticket (admin/agent only for tickets not created by them)

patch.description: Partially update ticket fields. Valid state transitions: open→pending/cancelled, pending→open/resolved/cancelled, resolved→open/pending/closed/cancelled

400.description: Invalid state transition or invalid priority

get.description: Retrieve all comments for a specific ticket
Get list of users with basic info for ticket assignment

BearerAuth.description: Type "Bearer" followed by a space and JWT token.
BearerAuth.name: Authorization
